axi.name: 阿汐
axi.role: 影像拾荒者 · 据点管理员
axi.letter: 阿汐把片架索引绳上的散页摊开，先看页角的旧编号，再将同一片罐的检修纸夹在后面。字迹不清的地方留着空白，旧页仍夹在原处。
axi.english: Axi spread the loose pages from the shelf index cord, checked the old corner numbers, then clipped each tin’s repair notes behind its sheet. She left unclear marks blank and kept the original pages in place.

chideng.name: 迟灯
chideng.role: 放映站守夜人 · 旧设备修理师
chideng.letter: 迟灯把新滤出的波段刻度抄进牛皮本，和片罐侧签对上了同一个号。
chideng.english: Chideng copied the newly filtered band markings into his kraft notebook, matching the number on the film tin's side label.

mitu.name: 弥途
mitu.role: 盐环路标师 · 往返列站的递信人
mitu.letter: 盐环列站的车门内侧新挂了一枚留白木签，等哪天亲脚走过再封上盐蜡。
mitu.english: A blank wooden tally hangs inside the Salt Ring carriage door, waiting for salt-wax once the road is actually walked.
